prompt: What was the pseudonym of one of the co-founders of the Eagle Awards that won Favourite Specialist Comics Publication/Trade Publication 1977 and 1978?
answer: One of the co-founders was **Michael “Mike” Conroy**; **Mike Conroy** was his pseudonym/byline. The publication was **Comic Media News**, which won the specialist/trade-publication award in 1977 and 1978.
